notes.title: Happy 1st birthday, Viltnemda!
notes.notes:
Happy birthday Viltnemda!

One year ago today, we uploaded Viltnemda to itch for the first time, which means that the game is one year old today! It is a game that has taught us a lot, and it's a game that we keep coming back to talking about internally on the regular, which we are so grateful and happy for!

Thank you so much to those of you in the past year that has played the game, given us genuine good feedback and lots of great comments. Releasing this game couldn't have done more for a couple of new game developers, it means the world to us!

Thanks everyone!

notes.title: Thank you for over 10k plays!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for over 10k players! We never dreamt of this at all, thank you so much for leaving comments, reviewing, tweeting, making videos, anything!
It has been a joy to watch!

Thanks for playing our little game, it means so much to us!

notes.title: You are Viltnemda
notes.notes:
Viltnemda is now officially released on steam!
Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted and waited for the game!

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: On June 24th, we are all Viltnemda.
notes.notes:
Yes! You heard that correctly! Game with new shiny achievements and everything! Wow!!

Thank you for your patience, and I hope you've grabbed your viltnemda outfit, it's forest time y'all
